title: ClaimShield agent result
description: What every ClaimShield analysis agent returns to the orchestrator, so the Fraud Risk & Decision agent can combine them the same way. Agent-specific data goes in `details`.

status.description: ok = all checks ran; partial = some checks skipped (e.g. a service was down), the score covers the rest; failed = the agent could not run, score is 0 and must not count as 'no risk'.

score.description: Points this agent adds to the claim's rule score (sum of warning_signs[].points).

score_max.description: Highest score this agent can give.

score_normalized.description: score / score_max, for comparing agents on one scale.

weighted_score.description: Points weighted by confidence (high 1.0, medium 0.7, low 0.4). Lets the decision agent discount weak signals.

agent_risk_level.description: This agent's own reading of its score. NOT the claim's route: only the Fraud Risk & Decision agent decides that.

evidence.description: One sentence an adjuster can verify. Never shown to the customer.

summary.description: One line for the adjuster's Slack message and the audit log.

details.description: Agent-specific data for the audit log.
